definitions.question: Is the frozen v0.6.0 protocol intact and runtime/implementation provenance self-consistent?
Is the run exactly bound to the E013 common-carrier manifest, with all E011 source geometries reloaded and hash-verified?
Do rigid-objectivity, constrained-objective identity, Armijo monotonicity and topology-proxy controls pass?
Can the fixed target-free constrained-objective selector drive the preregistered carrier fraction to stationary states, with numerical descent failures retained as UNRESOLVED?
Does the same frozen constrained-objective selector generalize without refit to registered confirmation topologies?
Does C++/OpenMP FP64 reproduce Python/NumPy FP64 for the state-selection energy kernel?
If available, does framework GPU/DD32 screening evidence remain consistent without being promoted to certification?
Do independently sourced provider anchors of the same topology converge to the same stationary endpoint without unresolved optimizer cases?
Are stationarity-qualified endpoints locally stable under a finite-difference-converged constrained Hessian and bounded ringdown on the same objective?
For source-energy-sensitive topologies, does numerically resolved state selection collapse provider spread toward a common endpoint?
Are clearance and link-drift topology proxies preserved along every completed state-selection path?
Can at least one provider-converged stationary, Hessian-converged, stable state be frozen as an A057-compatible handoff?
What is the overall state-selection evidence classification when numerical unresolved states are kept distinct from scientific FAIL?
After a completed FULL/CERTIFY blind run, do reveal and commitment checks verify exactly?
